Ref: 1) Head Office circular of even number dated 01.12.2015 (at SI. No. 522 of ‘Office
orders & circulars’ for 2015-16)
2) Head Office circular of even number dated 04.12.2015 (at SI. No. 532 of ‘Office
orders & circulars’ for 2015-16)

Sir/Madam,
Please refer to the above said subject.

2. It is clarified that Declaration Form can be accepted in case of UAN based claim form
without attestation of the employers. Henceforth, the attestation of employers on the
Declaration Form would not be required in case of UAN based Claim Form No. 31(UAN).

3. This has approval of the Central P.F. Commissioner.
